These alerts were removed from your status bar while the morning gate was on. Android does not let apps put them back in the shade — tap an item to open that app, or dismiss the log when you are done.
Tap dismiss when you are ready to start your morning.
Allow exact alarms so the wake-up time is reliable.

Morning Guard reads the app name, title, and text of notifications it holds, stores them on this phone, and shows them in the digest after your goal. It does not upload that text. Calls and text messages are not held. You can revoke access anytime in Android Settings → Apps → Special app access → Notification access.
